prompt.numbers: Fill the grid so every row, column and box has each number once.
prompt.pictures: Fill the grid so every row, column and box has each picture once.

spot.full-house: Find a row, column or box with one empty cell, and fill it.
spot.hidden-single-box: Where does {d} go? Scan the boxes.
spot.hidden-single-line: Where does {d} go? Scan the rows and columns.
spot.naked-single: Find a cell that can only be one number, and fill it.
spot.pointing: Use Pointing to find a place for {d}.
spot.claiming: Use Claiming to find a place for {d}.
spot.naked-pair: Use a Naked Pair to find a place for {d}.
spot.hidden-pair: Use a Hidden Pair to find a place for {d}.
spot.x-wing: Use an X-Wing to find a place for {d}.

right.title: Solved!
right.message: Every row, column and box is complete. Time {time}.

message.one: {count} cell is not right. It is marked. Tap it to change it.
message.other: {count} cells are not right. They are marked. Tap one to change it.

miss.title: Not that one
miss.notSure: That cell is not certain yet. Look again.

where.full-house: Look at {house}. It has only one empty cell.
where.hidden-single-box: Scanning: look at {house}. Where can {d} go?
where.hidden-single-line: Scanning: look along {house}. Where can {d} go?
where.naked-single: Look at {cell}. Which numbers can it still be?
where.pointing: Pointing: in {house}, every place for {d} is in {other}.
where.claiming: Claiming: in {house}, every place for {d} is inside {other}.
where.naked-pair: Naked Pair: two cells in {house} can only be {a} or {b}.
where.hidden-pair: Hidden Pair: in {house}, {a} and {b} fit only in the same two cells.
where.x-wing: X-Wing: in {house} and {other}, {d} fits in only two cells, in the same two {lines}.

why.full-house: The numbers {have} are already in {house}. The empty cell takes the one that is missing.
why.hidden-single-box: Rows and columns that already have {d} cross {house}. Only one cell in it is still free for {d}.
why.hidden-single-line: Every other empty cell in {house} already sees a {d} in its column, row or box.
why.naked-single: Its row, column and box already hold every number except {d}.
why.pointing: The {d} of {house} must be in {other}, so {d} cannot go anywhere else in {other}. Take those notes out.
why.claiming: The {d} of {house} must be inside {other}, so {d} cannot go anywhere else in {other}. Take those notes out.
why.naked-pair: Those two cells will take {a} and {b}, so no other cell in {house} can. Take those notes out.
why.hidden-pair: Those two cells must be {a} and {b}. Take every other note out of them.
why.x-wing: {d} sits on two corners of the square, one in each line. Take {d} out of the rest of those two {lines}.

hint.answerAfter: That opens up a number: put {d} in {cell}.
